sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2023/06/PXD011399/MQsearch_LeukemicLymph.zip (txt/summary.txt, txt/parameters.txt, txt/peptides.txt, first 400 kB of txt/msms.txt; read by HTTP range requests)
First 1.5 MB of each of the 13 RAW files under https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2023/06/PXD011399/ (HTTP range read, UTF-16 header strings)

Steinskog ESS et al. Microcirculation 2023;30(2-3):e12800, PMID 36702790, doi:10.1111/micc.12800 (abstract and MeSH via Europe PMC and NCBI efetch; full text on Wiley is blocked by a Cloudflare challenge and is not in PMC)

claims.evidence: PRIDE file list has exactly 13 RAW files, all with projectAccessions PXD011399. The original acquisition path in each RAW header (C:\Xcalibur\Data\SERVICE\Eli-Sihn_Steinskog\2015-08-25_QE-HF_P\Raw\<name>.raw) equals the deposited file name, so no file was renamed.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[disease], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[sampling site], factor values, all rows
claims.value: 1,4,7,13 control spleen lymph; 10,16 control liver lymph; 28,34,43,46 leukemic spleen lymph; 31 leukemic liver lymph; 49 pooled control plasma; 203 pooled leukemic plasma
claims.evidence: Deposited readme.txt: '1 lymph from healthy spleen' ... '10 lymph from healthy liver' ... '28 lymph from leukemic spleen', '31 lymph from leukemic liver' ... '49 - pooled plasma, healthy', '203 - pooled plasma, leukemic'. MaxQuant summary.txt experiment names (1, 4, ..., 203) match the number in each file name one to one.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10116; MaxQuant FASTA UP000002494_10116 (rat reference proteome); paper title 'in a rat model'; MeSH 'Rats'.

claims.value: acute myeloid leukemia (MONDO:0018874) for leukemic rows; normal for healthy rows
claims.evidence: Abstract: 'We used a rat model known to mimic human AML'; MeSH major topic 'Leukemia, Myeloid, Acute'. Readme labels samples 'healthy' vs 'leukemic'. PRIDE gives the broader 'acute leukemia' (DOID:12603); the paper's AML is more specific.

claims.location: characteristics[organism part] / characteristics[sampling site] / factor value[sampling site]
claims.value: lymph (UBERON:0002391) with sampling site spleen (UBERON:0002106) or liver (UBERON:0002107); blood plasma (UBERON:0001969) with sampling site blood (UBERON:0000178)
claims.evidence: Readme 'lymph from healthy spleen' / 'lymph from ... liver' / 'pooled plasma'. Abstract: 'By cannulating efferent lymphatic vessels from the spleen and liver'. Sampling site 'blood' for plasma is an inference (plasma is derived from blood); the draw site is not stated.

claims.value: 1..n within each disease x sampling site group, in sample-number order; plasma samples 49 and 203 'pooled'
claims.evidence: Readme lists each lymph sample by its own number and the two plasma samples as 'pooled plasma'. That each numbered lymph sample comes from a different rat is inferred from distinct sample numbers; no animal key is deposited.

claims.location: characteristics[developmental stage] / characteristics[strain or breed] / characteristics[sex]
claims.evidence: Neither the PRIDE record, the abstract, nor the PubMed MeSH headings (Animals, Humans, Rats, ...) state strain, sex or age. Full text not accessible.

All 13 RAW headers contain 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS' and the method 'Sensitive_TOP12HCD_120K-60K_2mmSH_IT5e4_90minRUN.meth'; the data folder is '2015-08-25_QE-HF_P'. This contradicts PRIDE instruments (LTQ Orbitrap Velos, MS:1001742) and the PRIDE sample protocol (LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro, CID in ion trap); raw data takes precedence.

claims.location: comment[dissociation method] / comment[collision energy] / comment[ms2 mass analyzer]
claims.evidence: RAW method: dd-MS2 'Resolution 60,000', 'NCE / stepped NCE 28'. MaxQuant msms.txt sample: all 839 PSMs read have Fragmentation 'HCD' and Mass analyzer 'FTMS'.

claims.location: comment[ms1 scan range] / comment[ms2 scan range] / comment[ms min charge] / comment[ms max charge]
claims.evidence: RAW method: Full MS scan range '375 to 1500 m/z'; dd-MS2 scan range '200 to 2000 m/z'; 'Charge exclusion unassigned, 1, 6 - 8, >8' (so charges 2-5 were selected).
RAW method 'TopN 12' dd-MS2; PRIDE protocol 'operated in the DDA-mode'.

Protocol 'digestion using porcine trypsin'; MaxQuant summary.txt Enzyme 'Trypsin/P' for all 13 runs; peptides.txt: 3790 of 3843 target, non-contaminant peptides end in K or R (rest are protein C-termini).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Acetyl Protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: parameters.txt 'Fixed modifications Carbamidomethyl (C)'; summary.txt 'Variable modifications Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term)' for every run; data processing protocol agrees.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Data processing protocol 'Precursor mass tolerance was 10 ppm (20 ppm in MaxQuant)'; parameters.txt 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm', which applies because MS2 was read in the Orbitrap (FTMS).
Sample processing protocol 'reduced using dithiothreitol (DTT ...) and alkylated ... using iodoacetamide (IAA ...)'; consistent with fixed Carbamidomethyl (C) in MaxQuant.

limitations: Full text of the paper (Wiley, CC BY-NC-ND) could not be retrieved: Wiley returns a Cloudflare challenge and the article is not in PMC. Only the abstract and PubMed MeSH were read.

The PRIDE LC-MS protocol text (LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro, CID, ion-trap MS2, 300-2000 m/z, top 7) does not match the RAW files (Q Exactive HF, HCD, Orbitrap MS2, 375-1500 m/z, top 12). All acquisition values come from the RAW headers. The digestion part of the same protocol (DTT, IAA, trypsin) was kept; trypsin and carbamidomethylation are independently confirmed by the MaxQuant output, DTT and IAA are not.
Strain, sex and developmental stage are not stated in any accessible source; written as 'not available'.
No animal key is deposited. Biological replicate numbers assume each numbered lymph sample is a different rat; whether spleen and liver lymph came from the same animals is unknown.
The number of animals in each plasma pool is not stated; no SN= members are listed.
Sampling site 'blood' for the plasma pools is an inference from the material; the draw site is not stated.
Precursor tolerance 20 ppm is taken from the protocol sentence about MaxQuant; MaxQuant 1.5 parameters.txt does not record first/main search tolerances, so it may describe the first search only.
